title: Harmonic Security, which uses small language models to inspect employee interactions with AI tools, raised a $50M Series B, taking its total funding to $76M (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: Harmonic Security, which uses small language models to inspect employee interactions with AI tools, raised a $50M Series B, taking its total funding to $76M — Workplace artificial intelligence security startup Harmonic Security Inc. today announced it has raised $50 million in new funding …
